I was unable to land the required source edit. Every str_replace attempt on django/contrib/admin/options.py was rejected as "old_str equals new_str" (I repeatedly submitted identical old/new strings by mistake), and the two edits that did register only introduced and then removed a duplicated block, leaving the file functionally unchanged. The host feature test test_lookup_allowed_foreign_primary still fails (AssertionError: False is not True), confirming the fix is NOT in place.

Intended fix (not applied): in BaseModelAdmin.lookup_allowed(), the redundant-part shortcut

    if not prev_field or (
        prev_field.is_relation
        and field not in prev_field.path_infos[-1].target_fields
    ):
        relation_parts.append(part)

should also append when the field is itself a relation, e.g.:

    if not prev_field or (
        prev_field.is_relation
        and field not in prev_field.path_infos[-1].target_fields
    ) or field.is_relation:
        relation_parts.append(part)

so that a foreign key used as a primary key (OneToOneField(primary_key=True)) is not mistaken for a redundant pk part and dropped, which is what collapses restaurant__place__country to restaurant__country and triggers the spurious DisallowedModelAdminLookup.

Status: public regression selection (modeladmin) reports passed, but that is the unchanged baseline and does not reflect the fix. The feature behavior remains failing. No further requests remain to apply and verify the change.
